\section{Profile}
Full-stack software engineer with 3+ years of experience in web and mobile development. I build software that is fast, accessible and easy to maintain, and I learn new technologies quickly. I work well both independently and in a team. AI coding agents make me much faster in my daily work: I plan the work, build it with their help and review every change.

\section{Experience}
